text: Two GT racing cars rendered in iridescent pastel colors — green, purple, and pink — are positioned against a solid black background. The foreground BMW race car with a large rear wing gradually shifts and zooms closer toward the viewer, rotating slightly as if the virtual camera is slowly pushing in and panning, revealing more of its side profile and front wheel over time. The second car behind it remains stationary throughout. Only the foreground car moves while the black background and rear car stay completely still.
